Few weeks ago  ,  I started working on audio processing . The task consists to make detections on a large audio file and multiple audios at the same time. To make it faster , we need to cut the audio in multiple segments and proceed the detections on each segment independantly and the most "parralelized " way possible. During this journey , I learnt about OS, processes , threads and all stuff related to concurrent programming with Python . Here I will try to share what I have discovered along.

***Let's go !!***
